Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

 As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

 We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 Why Join Coalition Technologies? 

 Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

- 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade

- Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month

- Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance

- Subsidized gym memberships

- Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members

- International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members

- Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs

- Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards

- Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 Office Assistant Responsibilities 

 As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

- Answering phones and emails

- Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records

- Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members

- Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members

- Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports

- Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments

- Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry

- Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year

- Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year

- Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 Required Skills and Qualifications 

 The ideal candidate will have:

- Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills

- High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness

- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

- Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks

- Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible

- Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time

- Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 Preferred Skills 

- The following experience is preferred but not required:

- Intermediate spreadsheet skills

- Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping

- Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace

- Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 Remote Work Environment 

 Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 Growth Opportunity 

 This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 Compensation 

 For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

About the Role
 Lead data operations for projects supporting advanced AI development. As part of a flexible expert network, you will be matched with projects that fit your background and work directly with project teams to help ensure the quality of datasets used to train and evaluate models.
 What You'll Do

- Lead data sourcing and collection programs by writing specifications, setting acceptance criteria, and tracking yield and quality.

- Coordinate media capture and document contributions at scale, then curate and validate the resulting datasets.

- Design synthetic data generation pipelines and validation checks to determine which data meets project standards.

- Review annotations, resolve disagreements, and run calibration and audit rounds with annotator teams.

- Write and maintain labelling guidelines, addressing gaps and updating guidance as edge cases arise.

- Coach reviewers and annotators, and report agreement rates, error rates, and other quality metrics to project teams.

 What We're Looking For

- At least 5 years of experience in data operations, annotation QA, data quality, dataset management, or a related field; alternatively, 5+ years of domain expertise with hands-on human-data work.

- Experience leading or reviewing others' work on data projects, such as as a QA lead, guideline owner, adjudicator, team lead, or project manager.

- Experience running data sourcing or collection programs, writing specifications, setting acceptance criteria, and tracking results.

- Experience owning labelling guidelines and running annotation review, calibration, or audit rounds, including measuring agreement or error rates.

- Hands-on familiarity with tools such as Label Studio, Labelbox, CVAT, Scale, Remotasks, or Appen, plus spreadsheets or SQL for quality analysis.

- Clear written communication, with the ability to explain data quality issues and solutions.

- Experience with synthetic data validation, media capture, document contribution, large-scale dataset curation, or coaching annotators is useful.

 Compensation & Benefits
 Compensation is $45 to $90 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience level. Payment is for hours worked.
 Location
 Fully remote. Projects may last from one week to several months.

About the Role
 Join an expert network supporting AI model evaluation projects as a safety tester. You will identify and document ways AI systems can fail, helping improve model safety across projects matched to your background.
 What You'll Do

- Write prompts and multi-turn conversations that test whether models follow safety guidelines.

- Try known and novel jailbreak techniques, and record which approaches succeed or fail.

- Use hidden instructions in documents and tool outputs to test for prompt injection vulnerabilities.

- Evaluate whether models using tools such as code, browsers, or email can be manipulated into harmful actions.

- Compare responses across demographic groups, names, and languages to identify potential bias.

- Review model responses against written safety policies and flag violations.

- Label content as safe or unsafe according to project guidelines.

 What We're Looking For

- 0 to 5 years of professional experience; prior AI data work is not required.

- Experience in security testing, CTFs, trust and safety, content moderation, policy analysis, fairness or bias research, adversarial machine learning, quality assurance, or a relevant cyber, bio, or chemical domain.

- Experience testing software, systems, or models by trying to break them and documenting steps and results.

- Experience applying written policies or guidelines to judge or label content or behavior.

- Familiarity with language model jailbreaks, prompt injection, or red teaming is useful.

- Familiarity with Burp Suite, Garak, PyRIT, similar tools, or the OWASP LLM Top 10 is useful.

- Strong written English, careful documentation habits, and the ability to work with sensitive content under structured guidelines.

 Compensation & Benefits
 Compensation is $30 to $60 per hour, depending on project, field, and experience. Payment is based on hours worked.
 Location
 Fully remote.

About the Role: 
 At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. 
 What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 

- 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. 

- Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. 

- Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. 

- Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. 

- Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. 

 Qualification path
  What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): 

- Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). 

- Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. 

- English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. 

- Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. 

 Assessment: 
 In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. 
 Payment: 
 Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour 
 Our Payment terms are defined for each project. 
 Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: 

- Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts.

- Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day.

- Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies.

- Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. 

 Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology.
 TELUS Digital AI Community 
 Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.
 Independent Contractor Relationship 
 This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Customer Service Executive — uPhone
 uPhone · Fully remote (work from anywhere) · Full-time · Apply to 
 Posted 18 November 2026 · Open until 17 January 2027
 Fully remote — work from anywhere in the world, with no country restriction. Compensation is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
 About uPhone
 uPhone is an eSIM marketplace built for modern travellers, available at (). The service is operated by Targa Limited, a company registered in Hong Kong. The team is small, remote-first, and based across Europe and Asia.
 uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
 What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract.
 uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service.
 Company values, as stated on the About Us page: transparency (what you see is what you pay), simplicity (purchase to connected in under two minutes), reliability (24/7 support and a clear refund policy), and sustainability (digital eSIMs mean zero plastic waste).
 The role
 We are hiring a Customer Service Executive to be a frontline point of contact for travellers using uPhone eSIM.
 You will help customers choose a plan, install their eSIM, troubleshoot connection issues, and understand refunds and top-ups — over live chat and email. Many conversations happen just before a flight or just after landing, so clear, accurate, and calm help matters. This is a fully remote, full-time role — you can work from anywhere in the world. Support is published as 24/7, with a typical response time under two minutes, so this role includes shift work. That may include evenings, nights, weekends, or public holidays, as agreed with the team.
 You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to follow documentation, explain technical steps in plain language, and know when to escalate.
 Responsibilities
 - Respond to customer questions on live chat and email within the team's service standards, aiming to protect the published typical response time of under two minutes.
 - Help travellers choose an appropriate country, regional, or global plan (including unlimited and longer-stay monthly or yearly options) and explain what is included: uPhone plans are data-only; the physical SIM and home number can stay in the phone; calls and texts go through apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage.
 - Walk customers through purchase, QR-code delivery, installation on iPhone and Android, and when to activate (profiles can be installed before travel; data should usually be turned on at the destination so validity starts when it is needed).
 - Troubleshoot common issues using the documented playbooks: device compatibility, carrier locks, APN settings, activation delays (typically under two minutes, occasionally up to around ten), coverage at the destination, top-ups, and exhausted data.

 About Hiredfy 

 Hiredfy is a boutique nearshore talent agency that connects US companies with pre-vetted, English-fluent professionals from Latin America. We pride ourselves on personal vetting — every candidate is interviewed by a human, no AI keyword filtering.

 About the Role 

 We're hiring on behalf of a US client looking for an L2 Incident Management / Support Analyst to join their team full-time. In this role, you'll receive system alerts, interpret what they mean, and follow runbooks to restart servers or services and resolve the issue. When a runbook isn't enough, you'll escalate — but only after digging deep enough to understand what's really going on.

 You'll work closely with the client's internal team and keep clients updated through Teams or Slack while incidents are being worked on and once they're resolved. This is a full-time role (40 hrs/week),5 days per week, with overlap during U.S. business hours. Some weekend coverage may be required on a rotating basis, coordinated with the team, to ensure continuous 24/7 support coverage.

 Requirements

 What You'll Do 

- Monitor alerts and incidents using tools like Dynatrace, Datadog, Kibana, Google Analytics, and QuantumMetric

- Read, interpret, and follow runbooks/playbooks to restart servers, services, or applications

- Investigate issues from multiple angles before concluding root cause — not just checking the basics

- Escalate unresolved issues with clear, well-documented context

- Spot patterns and anomalies, and proactively flag anything that looks "off"

- Document findings and recommend process improvements to reduce future resolution time

 Requirements 

- Based in Latin America with reliable internet

- Fluent in English (written and verbal), B2 level or higher — you'll communicate daily with a US-based team and share written incident updates with clients via Teams or Slack

- Background in SRE or incident management

- At least 1 year of hands-on experience with 1–2 monitoring/observability tools (Dynatrace, Datadog, Kibana, Google Analytics, QuantumMetric, or similar)

- Curious, critical problem-solver — you dig into issues from multiple angles before concluding root cause, and you think independently

- Proven ability to learn new tools quickly, plus the initiative to flag anomalies and suggest process improvements

- Available full-time (40 hrs/week) with overlap with US business hours

 Nice to Have 

- Broader hands-on experience across several of the tools listed above

- Experience with data analysis or data science concepts

- Ability to turn complex technical issues into clear, simple summaries

 A note on AI :

 We love AI — but we're not looking for someone who just copies and pastes AI-generated answers. The team already works with AI tools every day. What they need is someone who thinks critically and independently, and uses AI to sharpen their own reasoning, not replace it.

 Benefits

 What You'll Get 

- Competitive salary ($2,800 USD/month, paid in USD)

- 100% remote role, full-time

- Direct collaboration with US-based teams and clients

- 
 Hiredfy 's ongoing support throughout your onboarding

- Personal review of your profile — no AI filtering

Job Title: Video Data Entry Specialist (LATAM)
 Job Type: Contractor
 Location: Remote - experts based in Latin America and the Caribbean. Selected countries include:
 Argentina, Bahamas, Barbados, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Mexico, Panama y Uruguay.
 Job Summary: In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.
 Key Responsibilities:

- Capture precise motion data using your smartphone’s IMU sensors during specified physical activities.

- Record synchronized video footage to ensure data accuracy and enhance the integrity of all collected motion data.

- Follow detailed technical protocols to consistently meet strict quality, labeling, and determinism standards.

- Deliver a minimum of 10 hours of high-quality, approved video data each week throughout the project’s duration.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with the team to clarify requirements and share insights on data collection practices.

- Maintain timely and reliable delivery of your outputs, aligned with project milestones and expectations.

- Participate in device compatibility checks and an innovative, AI-enabled interview process as part of onboarding.

 Required Skills and Qualifications:

- Access to a head strap to be able to record both hands within 48 hours of the start date.

- Supported devices include the iPhone 12 and later, Google Pixel 6 and later, and Samsung Galaxy S21 and later.

- Meticulous attention to detail and a proven record of following standardized protocols.

- Demonstrated ability to consistently manage output and meet deadlines in a dynamic, data-driven environment.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills essential for documentation and remote collaboration.

- Advanced tech-savviness and experience with mobile devices for sensor and video data capture.

- Physical ability to engage in repetitive movement tasks safely and effectively.

- Access to a compatible smartphone capable of high-fidelity data collection.

- 
 Note: Applications submitted with a Gmail address are strongly preferred for seamless tool integration.

 Preferred Qualifications:

- Background in robotics, kinesiology, sensor-based data collection, or related technical disciplines.

- Experience with human motion analysis, activity segmentation, or machine learning dataset labeling.

- Familiarity with structuring large-scale datasets for AI and robotics applications.

 Compensation Structure
 Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per recorded video that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply: videos must be at a specific length defined by the project, and experts must submit a minimum of 10 to 15 hours of video per week .
 Start Timeline & Availability
 We typically fill roles within 48 hours , so we’re looking for teammates who are ready to jump in. If selected, we’d love for you to start your first task as soon as you move forward with your application. The expectation is to begin within ~24 hours of completing onboarding. 
 Equipment Requirements
 Mobile:
 Tasks for this project must be performed from a mobile device (smartphone) . Experts will record their workflow directly from the mobile device while completing tasks.
 Head Strap / Wearable: Tasks for this project must be performed using a head-mounted camera (head strap setup) . Experts will record first-person video of physical tasks. The required head strap and any accompanying equipment specifications will be shared during onboarding.
 IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
 Candidates who meet the project’s location and equipment requirements will be contacted soon to complete an identity verification process. Selected candidates should be able to complete this ID verification within 48 hours of being contacted. Successful verification is required before the contract can be issued for signature.

About The Role

 We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.
 We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.
 As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

 All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

 Your routine responsibilities will include:

- Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

- Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

- Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

- Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

- Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

 Who are you?
 You areâ¦

- A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

- Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

- Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

- A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

- Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

- Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

- Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

 At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

 Other details

- This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

- You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

- You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

- This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

- Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

 Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there. 

 Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements

Work From Anywhere in LATAM or the Philippines
 Work Schedule: US Timezone (Flexible) │ 3–5 hours daily overlap with US business hours
 About Pearl Talent 

 Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.
 Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for: Watch here 
 About the Client
 A healthcare technology company that builds AI-powered workflow software for independent neurology practices is looking for a Clinical Referral Coordinator to own the review and qualification of incoming patient referrals.
 Founded in 2023, the company supports 7 neurology practices and more than 140 providers. Its platform automates about 80% of referral processing. The remaining cases need a trained reviewer who can read clinical documents and apply each practice’s rules accurately.
 About the Role
 Day-to-day, you will review referrals in the company’s internal system, read clinical notes and imaging reports, and decide whether each referral is accepted, needs more information, or is denied. You will also call patients to schedule approved appointments and collect missing information. A co-founder reviews every decision during your ramp. Success means qualifying 50–60% of straightforward referrals on your own by day 30 and handling the full queue independently by day 90.
 Core Responsibilities
 Clinical Referral Qualification

- Review incoming neurology referrals and decide to accept, request more information, or deny based on practice-specific rules

- Read multi-page clinical documents, including MRI reports, prior neurologist notes, and primary care summaries, to find details that change a decision

- Confirm all required documents are present before a referral moves to scheduling

- Record the rationale for every decision in the internal comments field

 Patient Communication & Scheduling

- Call patients to schedule appointments once referrals are approved

- Contact patients or referring offices to collect missing clinical or insurance information

- Log call outcomes and follow-ups in the referral system

 Quality & Ramp

- Qualify 50–60% of straightforward referrals independently within the first 30 days

- Apply feedback from full decision review to reduce errors through day 90

- Escalate unclear or edge-case referrals before making a decision

- Learn and apply new qualification rules as additional practices are onboarded

 Requirements

 Must-Have 

- 2+ years in a healthcare operations role with clinical document review in scope (referral coordination, prior authorization, utilization review, or medical records review) 

- Hands-on review of multi-page clinical documents, including physician notes, specialist assessments, and MRI or imaging reports 

- Experience applying clinical or practice-specific criteria to accept, deny, or request more information on referrals or authorizations 

- Working knowledge of medical terminology, including telling document types apart (e.g., imaging report vs. imaging order) 

- Outbound patient call experience for appointment scheduling or collecting missing information 

- Experience supporting US-based healthcare providers, practices, or health systems 

- English at C1+ (CEFR) for live, unscripted calls with US patients 

 Nice-to-Have 

- Neurology or other complex specialty referral experience (oncology, multi-specialty) 

- Athena Health EHR, or another named US EMR such as Epic or eClinicalWorks 

- Healthcare BPO background serving US specialty or multi-specialty practices 

- Experience working with automated or AI-assisted intake or referral systems 

 Benefits 

- Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills 

- Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere 

- Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting 

- Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy 

- Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees 

- Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts 

- Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth 

- Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide 

 Our Recruitment Process 

- Application 

- Screening 

- Skills Assessment 

- Topgrading Interview 

- Client Interview 

- Job Offer 

- Client Onboarding 

 Ready to Join Us? 
 If you’re empathetic, organized, and passionate about improving patient experiences through operational excellence, this role is for you. Apply now to help make specialized healthcare more accessible to patients across the U.S.

About FreedUp 

 FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
 About the role
 We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.
 His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. You’ll take ownership of both: triaging his email, responding where appropriate, routing what needs his attention, and building his scheduling system from scratch.
 This is not a task-taker role. He needs someone with strong judgment who can quickly learn who’s who and what matters, decide what’s urgent, and keep things moving without waiting to be told. Your first 30 days will focus on fixing his top three time-killers, and by 90 days you should be running his inbox and calendar with confidence.
 This is a part-time, remote position. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion.
 Compensation: 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience)
 Location: Remote, LATAM
 Job Type: Part-time
 What you'll do
 Email triage and responsiveness (main priority) 

- Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it.

- Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice.

- Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval.

- Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

 Judgment-based routing 

- Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d.

- Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled.

- Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems.

 Calendar and scheduling 

- Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules.

- Schedule calls and meetings with lenders, lawyers, brokers, contractors and internal staff.

- Protect his time so his calendar reflects his real priorities.

 Process and partnership 

- Hold regular check-ins with him to review open items, routing decisions and what to adjust.

- Build and maintain a living playbook of routing rules, key contacts and recurring processes.

- Spot recurring time drains and propose practical fixes.

 Our hiring process

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself, then a prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

 Requirements
 Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar executive support role, including experience working with US-based executives or companies.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Confident replying to emails on an executive's behalf, in his voice.

- High discretion with financial, legal and tenant information.

- Available part-time with consistent overlap during US business hours (exact schedule confirmed during the process).

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

 Nice-to-haves

- Experience in real estate, property management, multifamily, acquisitions or development.

- Experience working with lenders, lawyers, insurance claims or accounting teams.

- Familiarity with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi, Buildium).

- Experience setting up inbox rules, labels or automations in Gmail or Outlook.

- Comfortable using AI tools to triage and draft email faster.

- Experience writing and maintaining SOPs or playbooks.

 Benefits

- Compensation in USD

- Year-end bonus, plus other applicable bonuses

- Health insurance allowance

- PTO + Holidays

- Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

Sobre nosotros
 Draftea es la startup de tecnología mexicana que está revolucionando el mundo de las apuestas. Creada por y para los aficionados a los deportes, estamos respaldados por inversionistas de clase mundial como Sequoia, Kaszek y Bullpen. Nuestra razón de ser es sencilla: darle a los aficionados una nueva forma de disfrutar su pasión. Queremos que todos los amantes de los deportes puedan sentir como si cada partido fuera la final del mundial y cada triunfo una razón para celebrar. Queremos acercar a nuestros jugadores a sus ídolos y equipos y hacerlos partícipes de las emociones que se viven dentro del campo.
 Nuestra cultura
 Construimos un producto orientado al entretenimiento de nuestros usuarios, es por esto que promovemos un entorno de trabajo donde trabajamos duro pero al mismo tiempo la pasamos bien y en donde cada persona puede trabajar con compañeros igualmente motivados y con un alto rendimiento. Creemos y confiamos en la flexibilidad horaria en donde el objetivo es la consecución de resultados es por esto que buscamos a alguien a quien le apasione el producto, la función y el reto, y que no busque simplemente otro trabajo de 9 a 5. 
Somos una empresa "remote-first". Esto significa que, aunque tenemos una oficina en Ciudad de México y Buenos Aires nuestro equipo está trabajando desde diferentes países (Perú, Colombia, Chile, Uruguay, Argentina, República Dominicana, Estados Unidos).
 Objetivo de la posición
 El especialista tendrá la responsabilidad de atender a los usuarios que se contacten a través de nuestros canales de atención, buscando siempre superar sus expectativas de servicio. Debe ser un apasionado del servicio, empático y resolutivo.
 El Customer Experience Specialist debe tener excelentes habilidades de comunicación, ya que hablará directamente con los clientes. Además, deben tener una sólida comprensión de los productos y servicios de su empresa para abordar las preguntas de los clientes. También debe tener una actitud agradable y capacidad de negociación.
 Desafíos de la posición 

- Atender las interacciones online y offline de nuestros clientes.

- Ofrecer soluciones y alternativas adecuadas utilizando procesos definidos dentro de los tiempos establecidos y realizar un seguimiento para garantizar la resolución.

- Revisar resultados y estadísticas de juegos.

- Gestión de crisis y situaciones sensibles: En situaciones donde los clientes enfrentan emergencias relacionadas con la plataforma Draftea , el Customer Experience Specialist deberá manejar estas situaciones con sensibilidad y eficacia.

- Resolución de problemas complejos, colaborar con los equipos internos con la finalidad de llegar a una solución para satisfacer las necesidades de nuestros clientes.

- Adaptación a las necesidades cambiantes: Las necesidades y expectativas de los clientes pueden evolucionar con el tiempo, lo que requiere una adaptación continua de las estrategias y procesos de éxito del cliente.

 About Proof 

 Launched in 2018, Proof is a national platform for service of process supporting thousands of law firms across the United States. We connect law firms with process servers and enable electronic court filing through a modern, technology-driven platform — automating document ingestion, compliance, real-time job matching, and integrations with leading legal software. Today, Proof delivers over 60,000 documents per month through a network of ~2,000 contracted process servers.

 About the role

 A Dispatch Specialist I is the front line of Proof's marketplace. You ensure all service of process jobs in your territory are successfully dispatched by connecting job opportunities with independent contractor process servers. You negotiate fairly with both clients and servers and learn from every job outcome. Your work directly shapes the client experience, server relationships, and marketplace economics in the territory you own.

 What you'll do

- Own a territory. Become the subject-matter expert on the operational requirements (e.g., regional licensing and coverage rules) for the regions you're assigned.

- Build relationships with servers. Servers are independent contractors who choose which jobs to take. Call, text, and email them respectfully and professionally. Take notes on their preferences. Find solutions that work for both sides of the marketplace.

- Communicate with clients. Handle client conversations by phone and email, negotiating the path that works best for everyone.

- Negotiate fair pricing. Set prices that work for the server and the business, and hold the line when it counts.

- Document everything. Keep records of client and server communications and the decisions you made on the job.

- Improve as you go. Spot inefficiencies in your workflow. Share pricing and network gaps with the broader team to strengthen the market.

- Support your peers. Help teammates solve problems when they ask. Contribute to an overall team that runs better because you're on it.

- Use data to learn. Use data and dashboards to track your own performance, identify trends, and improve your decisions and workflows.

 Who you are

- A customer-oriented communicator. You're respectful and kind, even when things are hard or moving fast.

- Detail-oriented and organized. You don't let things slip through the cracks. Your task queue stays clean. You write clear notes that support your decisions.

- A negotiator. You can hold a price, explain the why, and find creative paths forward when the first option doesn't work.

- Data-curious. You're comfortable opening a dashboard, asking a question, and using the answer to improve your work.

 Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

 Carrot is looking for a Director, Information Security to lead the security program that protects the highly sensitive fertility and family-building data of members around the world.  Day to day, you will balance setting direction with staying close to the work: prioritizing risk with Engineering and IT, guiding audit and certification cycles, coaching a small and talented team, and joining customer conversations where security is part of the buying decision. Carrot has already earned SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, HITRUST, and PCI DSS compliance, so this role is about taking a strong foundation to the next level of maturity, not starting from scratch.

 What makes this role different is the combination of stakes and influence. Few security leaders get to protect data this personal, at global scale, while working directly with executive leadership and shaping how a health platform is built, sold, and trusted.

 What You’ll Own 💼 

 In this role, you will:

- Lead Carrot's security strategy and roadmap, using a recognized maturity model (such as C2M2 or NIST CSF) to prioritize investments and report progress to executive leadership

- Own the full security program across corporate security (GRC, incident management, security awareness, third-party risk) and product security (application security, cloud and infrastructure security, secure SDLC)

- Partner with Engineering, especially the Internal Platform team, to build security into how Carrot designs, ships, and operates its systems, going beyond compliance

- Lead internal risk assessments across application, cloud, and corporate environments and turn the results into prioritized technical safeguards

- Direct incident response readiness, including playbooks, tabletop exercises, executive communication, and post-incident learning

- Represent Carrot's security posture to employers, health plans, and health systems through security reviews, questionnaires, and strategic sales conversations

- Work with Legal and Privacy to meet global data protection requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) for member health data

- Manage the security budget, tooling, and vendor relationships, and tailor security guidance for a remote-first workforce and physical offices

 What Success Looks Like 📈 

 In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

- A documented, executive-endorsed security strategy and multi-year roadmap with clear priorities, owners, and measures of progress

- Clean outcomes on recurring audits and certifications (SOC 2 Type II, HITRUST, PCI DSS), with remediation items closed on schedule

- A tested incident response program, with regular tabletop exercises completed and lessons learned built back into the program

- A measurable reduction in high-risk vulnerabilities and open security findings, with remediation timelines agreed on with Engineering

- A living risk register and vendor security review process that leaders rely on to make decisions

- A security team with defined roles, clear growth paths, and the right capacity for Carrot's growth, including key hires made

- A clear plan, and visible progress, on any additional framewor

“ Mineralys Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing medicines to target hypertension and related comorbidities such as chronic kidney disease (CKD), obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and other diseases driven by dysregulated aldosterone. Its initial product candidate, lorundrostat, is a proprietary, orally administered, highly selective aldosterone synthase inhibitor. Mineralys is headquartered in Radnor, Pennsylvania. For more information, please visit https://mineralystx.com . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn , Twitter and Bluesky ”

 Mineralys is a fully remote company.

 Regional Sales Director 

 The Regional Sales Director (RSD) will play a critical role in the successful launch and growth of Mineralys’ first commercial product within an assigned region. This leader will be accountable for translating national strategy into regional execution, driving business performance through strong field leadership, cross-functional partnership, and disciplined execution against launch objectives.

 The RSD will build and lead a high-performing team of territory managers, foster deep customer relationships, and ensure alignment with corporate priorities, compliance standards, and Mineralys’ values. This is a highly visible field leadership role requiring strong business acumen, launch experience, and the ability to lead with urgency in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

 Key Responsibilities 

 Commercial Leadership / Launch Execution 

- Lead all regional launch planning and execution activities to ensure successful market entry and sustained product uptake

- Translate national brand strategy into actionable regional business plans and field execution priorities

- Lead team to achieve or exceed sales goals, market share targets, and key performance metrics at launch and beyond

- Monitor market dynamics, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence to adjust strategy in real time

- Drive accountability for performance through data-driven decision making and disciplined execution

 Team Leadership / Coaching 

- Recruit, onboard, develop, and retain top-performing territory managers across the region

- Lead, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 8–12 territory managers

- Establish and maintain high level of disease state, clinical and product knowledge

- Evaluate performance of territory managers and coach to skill and career development through regular field contact

- Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement

- Build strong succession plans and talent pipelines

 Customer / Market Engagement 

- Develop and maintain relationships with key healthcare providers, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and strategic accounts

- Partner with territory managers on key customer interactions, access challenges, and develop account strategies

- Support pull-through with IDNs, organized customers, and priority accounts

- timely and effectively sharing of customer insights with internal stakeholders

 Cross-Functional Collaboration 

- Partner closely with Market Access, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Training, Operations, and HR to support launch readiness and execution

- Provide field-driven input into brand planning, messaging, and tactical adjustments

- Collaborate with Area Sales Directors and peers to share best practices and drive consistency across regions

- Support national meetings, launch planning sessions, and field communications

 Compliance / Operational Excellence 

- Ensure all regional activities are conducted in full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and legal standards

- Manage regional budgets and resources effectively

- Maintain accurate forecasting, CRM utilization, and reporting discipline

- Uphold Mineralys’ values of collaboration, integrity, quality, trust, and urgency

 Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

- 8+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech sales experience

- 3+ years of people leadership experience in a district / regional manager role

- Proven success leading specialty sales teams and exceeding performance goals

- Prior launch experience required; first-launch / startup biotech experience strongly preferred

- Experience in cardiovascular, nephrology, hypertension, or related specialty markets strongly preferred

- Demonstrated success in recruiting and developing top talent

- Strong business planning, analytical, and coaching skills

- Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment

- Willingness to travel extensively within region

 Leadership Profile 

- A strong coach who develops people and builds winning teams

- Highly accountable, with a bias for action and urgency

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping build infrastructure

- Collaborative and able to influence across functions

- Resilient, adaptable, and energized by launch environments

 T

 Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

 Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

About AMBOSS 
 We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.
 Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.
 Position Summary 
 We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.
 Responsibilities Include 

- Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

- Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

- Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

- Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

- Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

- Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

 Qualifications 

- Medical degree (MD/DO). 

- Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S. 

- Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

- Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

- Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

- Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

- Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

 Logistics 

- Position type : Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

- Location : Fully remote

- Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

- Schedule : Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

- Compensation : $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

- Start date : As soon as possible

 Why join us? 

- Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

- Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

- Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

 We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

Overview 

 CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

 More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

 Your mission 

 As Product Engineer, you'll own customer problems from the first conversation to a working product. You'll talk to users, shape the idea, design the experience, and build it across the stack. You'll work closely with engineers, design, and our CPAs and Financial Planners to turn complicated financial work into software people can understand and trust.

 Your one-year outcomes

- 
 Customers rely on what you build. You've shipped meaningful features end to end, with evidence that customers use them and find them valuable.

- 
 More financial work gets done. Workflows you own help households and advisors complete tasks with less manual effort, fewer handoffs, and clearer next steps.

- 
 The experience holds up. Your features are easy to use and reliable in practice, including when information is missing, an integration fails, or a person needs to step in.

- 
 We learn and ship faster. You turn ambiguous problems into focused releases, learn from real usage, and use that evidence to decide what to improve next.

 What you will do 

- 
 Examples of what you could build:

- 
 Trading: Help users go from an investment idea to a reviewed trade, with clear approvals, execution status, and visibility into what happened.

- 
 Strategies: Build ways to discover financial ideas, understand their upside and tradeoffs, explore how they fit a household's situation, and turn a saved strategy into a plan of action.

- 
 Tax filing: Bring document collection, missing-information requests, CPA review, and filing progress into one clear experience for households and their tax team.

 Across these features, you'll:

- 
 Own problems from discovery to launch. Talk with customers and financial experts, identify what matters, and decide what to build first.

- 
 Design the experience. Sketch, prototype, and refine interfaces with our designer. Make complex decisions and workflows feel clear.

- 
 Build across the stack. Ship interfaces, backend services, integrations, and AI workflows. Follow the problem wherever the implementation takes you.

- 
 Turn agents into useful products. Build ways for people to understand, review, and approve an agent's work, including workflows that span external tools and websites.

- 
 Make the whole flow work. Handle incomplete information, interruptions, retries, and human handoffs. Verify that the task actually finished correctly.

- 
 Use AI tools to ship and iterate. Move quickly, understand and check what you ship, and keep improving it through customer feedback and usage.

 What we look for

- 
 Role-agnostic

- 
 Opportunity alignment: You want to help households manage complex finances and bring expert tax and financial planning to more people. You're excited to shape a product on a small, early team.

- 
 High agency: You see what needs doing and take responsibility for it. You can start with an incomplete brief, find the missing information, and make progress.

- 
 Exceptional collaboration: You make the people around you better: engineers, designers, CPAs, and Financial Planners. You seek feedback, say what you think, and follow through.

- 
 First-principles thinking: You start with the customer's problem, question assumptions, and can explain why your approach makes sense. You change your mind when the evidence changes.

- 
 Role-specific

- 
 Strong engineering fundamentals. You've built and shipped working software, can reason through unfamiliar systems, and care about correctness and maintainability.

- 
 Product judgment. You can turn an open-ended problem into a useful first release, explain what you left out, and define how you'll know it helped.

- 
 Design taste. You notice confusing interactions, care about the details, and can explain how your changes improve the experience.

- 
 You ship your own work. You're comfortable moving between the interface and backend, using AI coding tools

 Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

 About the role 

 This role runs the internal posture engine — the risk register, critical control monitoring, evidence, audit operations and GRC tooling. It keeps risk state current so the Lead and the Risk Committee decide from accurate data in the Risk Dashboard and reporting. Drata is the register of record. Named owners close gaps; this role keeps the register, evidence and audit operations current.

 Responsibilities 

 Planning 

- Operate the risk register from the Security Programme threat model: populate, track treatment, record acceptance decisions, follow up owners, and run the exceptions register.

- Keep the ISMS and security policy library current as part of audit readiness. Draft security standards when commissioned by the Lead.

- Run Drata as the control and evidence system — Statement of Applicability, framework crosswalk and automation.

 Execution 

- Run critical control monitoring: health check-ins, drift flags and Drata automation. Route drift to the SOC. Maintain the evidence file for Lead assessments and independent internal audit.

- Feed threat-assessment findings into the register and confidence ratings. Track which required assessments are current.

- Lead audit coordination and preparation: ISO 27001 and SOC 2 logistics, ISMS readiness, team prep, management-review pack, and customer due-diligence questionnaires.

- Coordinate the control register for external testing (red team, tabletop, pentest). Run security awareness and weekly alerts.

 Tracking and evaluating performance 

- Track residual risk, exceptions and gap-closure against appetite. Exceptions expire and are reported; the underlying requirement stays in force.

- Report register state and evidence health so the Lead and Risk Committee work from one view.

 Achieving overall defined performance

- Be accountable for a current, defensible posture engine — register, evidence and audit operations.

- Ensure Drata collects evidence continuously, with automated evidence where coverage exists.

 Qualifications

- Hands-on experience running a risk register, control library and audit cycle (ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2).

- Comfortable with GRC platforms (Drata or equivalent) and turning monitoring into evidence.

- Proven ability to coordinate audits and customer questionnaires with named control owners.

- Precise written work; register and Statement of Applicability quality matters.

- Strong stakeholder management with control owners and auditors.

- CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor, or equivalent professional certification.

 Don't meet all the requirements? Don't sweat it. We’re passionate about building a diverse team of humans and as such, if you think you've got what it takes for our chaotic-but-fun, remote-friendly, start-up environment—apply anyway, detailing your relevant transferable skills in your cover letter. While we have a pretty good idea of what we need, we're ready for you to challenge our thinking on who needs to be in this role.

 The salary range listed for this role applies to US-based candidates only. Compensation for candidates based outside the US (including Canada, EMEA, and LATAM) will be determined based on location, experience, and skills during the interview process, and may differ from the listed US range.

At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. 

 Our Values:

- We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

- We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. 

- We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. 

- We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. 

 The Position:

 We are seeking a motivated and scientifically rigorous Bioinformatics Scientist II to contribute to the development of next-generation minimal residual disease (MRD) laboratory-developed tests (LDTs). This role will support assay development efforts through bioinformatics analysis, experimental design, data interpretation, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams.

 The ideal candidate is an early-career scientist with a strong foundation in genomics, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS). Candidates may be recent Ph.D. graduates or individuals with 1 to 3 years of postdoctoral or industry experience. The successful candidate will be a creative problem solver, critical thinker, and collaborative scientist who enjoys working at the interface of computational biology and laboratory assay development.

 Key Responsibilities

 Bioinformatics Analysis & Assay Development

- Contribute to the design, development, evaluation, and optimization of NGS-based MRD assays.

- Perform bioinformatics analyses to support assay development, analytical validation, and performance characterization studies.

- Analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets and communicate findings to project teams.

- Develop and maintain reproducible analysis workflows and scripts for assay development activities.

- Support evaluation of assay performance metrics, including sensitivity, specificity, accuracy, reproducibility, and quality control metrics.

- Participate in benchmarking studies to evaluate and compare bioinformatics methods and analytical approaches.

 Experimental Design & Scientific Problem Solving

- Collaborate with wet-lab scientists to design experiments, analyze results, and drive data-informed decisions.

- Apply critical thinking and scientific reasoning to investigate assay performance, troubleshoot challenges, and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Contribute to the development of novel computational approaches and analytical methods as needed.

- Document analyses, methods, and study results in a clear and reproducible manner.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with assay development, molecular biology, software engineering, biostatistics, clinical, and quality teams to support program objectives.

- Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and project planning activities.

- Help translate biological and technical questions into computational analyses and actionable recommendations.

- Communicate results effectively to both computational and non-computational audiences.

 Quality & Documentation

- Follow established quality systems and development processes for regulated diagnostic assay development.

- Contribute to study documentation, development reports, validation summaries, and technical records.

- Support preparation of materials for regulatory submissions, audits, and design-control activities as appropriate.

 Who You Are:

 Required Qualifications

- D. in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Biomedical Engineering, Biostatistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

- Recent Ph.D. graduate and 2+ years of postdoctoral and/or industry experience or M.Sc and 5+ years of experience.

- Strong understanding of molecular biology, genetics, and next-generation sequencing technologies.

- Experience analyzing NGS data and developing computational workflows using Python and/or R.

- Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex datasets and draw scientifically sound conclusions.

- Strong critical thinking, quantitative reasoning, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative, cross-functional environment.

- Demonstrated scientific curiosity, initiative, and attention to detail.

 Preferred Qualifications

- Experience supporting development of NGS-based research or diagnostic assays.

- Familiarity with cancer genomics, somatic variant analysis, and liquid biopsy applications.

 Sales and qualification. Manage a portfolio of inbound and targeted outbound opportunities. Run discovery, assess product and customer fit, coordinate screening, handle objections, maintain momentum, and guide suitable prospects to a clear decision.

 Practical experience improving workflows with automation and AI, including judgment about where automation introduces unacceptable risk or a poor customer

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 About the role: 

 The Commercial Customer Success team supports hundreds to thousands of customers who depend on the Samsara platform daily. This team is dedicated to equipping every customer with the necessary resources to achieve rapid value, regardless of their background or expertise.
To scale this impact, we are seeking a Digital Customer Success Manager, AI & Automation to be a hands-on developer responsible for designing, testing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems to support a digital-first post-sales strategy.

 Key responsibilities include:

- Customer Journey Optimization: Pinpoint friction points in the customer experience, create proactive interventions, and turn interactions into automated, personalized journeys.

- End-to-End Execution: Write code, execute experimental tests, and continuously maintain production solutions.

- Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner across teams to ensure a cohesive experience for all users.

 Success is measured by key customer outcome metrics, including increased adoption, minimized churn risk, and higher NRR tied to the agents you deploy.

 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area. 

 You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.

- You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

- You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

- You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

- You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

 In this role, you will: 

- Analyze: Identify customer painpoints and areas of opportunity with an analytical mindset combined with a customer-centric lens.

- Build: Build the digital CS playbooks, taking advantage of the programs and resources other teams have built, design agent architectures, write prompts, integrate with external systems (Salesforce, Samsara platform, Customer Success tools), build guardrails, and write clean Python code that the team can maintain.

- Test: Define success criteria and evaluation frameworks before you write the first line of code. Build automated test suites that cover real-world scenarios, edge cases, and known failure modes.

- Deploy: Own the deployment, versioning, and rollback plan for every agent. Ensure agents are production-ready before they reach CSMs. Ensure anything we deploy makes the experience more simple, not more complex, for our customers.

- Monitor: Track agent performance in production — monitor accuracy, latency, failure rates, and customer outcomes. Detect drift before anyone has to tell you something's wrong.

- Maintain & Iterate: Update agents continuously as Samsara's product evolves, Customer Success playbooks change, and real-world data indicates what needs improvement.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara

 Responsibilities

- Confidently communicate the value of Side’s brokerage platform to drive engagement with prospects and deepen adoption, efficiency, and retention among partners.

 Qualifications

 About Koronet 

 Koronet is the leading vertical SaaS, B2B e-commerce, and payments software company for the over $50 Billion global B2B floral industry. Our solution consists of an inventory and operations management SaaS solution and an e-commerce network that enables end-to-end transactions through the B2B supply chain. The company has teams in Florida, Ecuador, Argentina, Uruguay, Netherlands and Colombia. Our global Network of partners includes hundreds of flower growers, importers, and wholesalers who collectively represent a material portion of the global flower market. Our mission is to be the unified operating floral supply chain by providing mission-critical business operations solutions powering the largest B2B e-commerce network.
 We are a fast-growing company backed by a leading growth equity fund, fueling our expansion across North America and Europe through both organic growth and acquisitions.
 About the role
 We’re looking for a Revenue Data Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team and help the business make better data-driven decisions. You’ll analyze revenue data, build the reports and dashboards our teams rely on, and help improve how we use our CRM, with Salesforce at the center.
 This role sits at the intersection of data and operations. You’ll translate business questions into analysis, and analysis into process improvements. Because we’re in the middle of an integration, you’ll often work with data from different systems and help bring structure where it’s still evolving. That’s a real challenge, and also a great opportunity to shape how revenue data works across the company.
 What you’ll do
 Data analysis & reporting 

- Analyze revenue streams, customer behavior, transactions, and usage trends to identify growth opportunities.

- Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and scorecards that track key revenue and business metrics.

- Keep our data reliable through regular audits, validation, and cleanup.

- Deliver ad-hoc analyses that support business decisions and revenue forecasting.

 Revenue process optimization 

- Help automate workflows and processes related to revenue tracking.

- Evaluate Salesforce functionality and recommend improvements to how we use it.

 Collaboration & support 

- Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to turn business needs into data insights.
