- Help train teams on data best practices and reporting tools.

 What we’re looking for

- 2+ years of experience in data analysis, revenue analytics, or CRM optimization.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Science, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Proficiency in SQL and Excel/Google Sheets.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce and with tools such as Metabase, Snowflake, or similar BI/data platforms.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A detail-oriented, proactive approach: you spot issues, dig into them, and resolve them independently.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Fluent English, written and spoken.

 Nice to have

- Experience in digital marketplaces or B2B e-commerce, including inventory, pricing, and price list management.

- A track record of using AI or automation to drive efficiencies in data or revenue processes.

- Background in commercial or operations strategy, with measurable impact on revenue growth.

 What We Offer

- Flexible, remote working environment.

 Why Join Koronet

About the Project 

 Project Hydrus is a scripted and conversational audio data collection project. We're looking for native-level speakers who can deliver natural, everyday-sounding speech — recordings that hold up whether you're reading a script or speaking spontaneously. 

 Please note: the recordings you produce may be used to create synthesized, AI-generated voices for conversational AI products. Full details on how your data is collected, used, shared, and retained are set out in a Consent Form, which you'll review and sign before any paid session recording begins. 

 What You'll Do If Selected: 

- 
 Two supervised sessions of approximately 4 hours each, guided in real time by a Session Director on a separate recording platform. 

- 
 Record scripted material in a natural, conversational tone — faithfully, without a polished, performed, or “announcer” delivery. 

- 
 Record unscripted, spontaneous speech on a given topic, matching the same warmth and pace as your scripted takes. 

- 
 Set up and manage your own recording space and equipment for session recording. 

- 
 Deliver all recordings entirely in the required language (with specific dialect), without code-switching into other languages or dialects. 

 What We're Looking For 

 Required 

- 
 Experience as a voice actor, actor, or theater performer, or a comparable performance background. 

- 
 Native or native-equivalent fluency in the required language (with specific dialect). 

- 
 Access to a quiet recording space, free of echo and background noise (acoustically treated for session recording, if selected). 

- 
 Owns or will acquire a dedicated, professional-grade microphone for the audition (e.g. RODE NT-USB Mini, Blue Yeti), upgrading to a qualifying USB condenser or XLR mic + audio interface for session recording if selected. Built-in laptop mics, AirPods, earbuds, and headsets are not accepted at any stage. 

- 
 Owns closed-back monitoring headphones (required for session recording if selected). 

- 
 Comfortable both self-directing for the audition and taking live direction from a Session Director in guided sessions. 

 Preferred (nice to have, not required) 

- 
 Professional voice-over experience (dubbing/ADR, audiobook, podcasting) in a conversational rather than commercial/announcer register. 

- 
 Baseline audio hygiene: comfortable setting mic distance and catching noise, clipping, or distortion yourself. 

- 
 An existing home recording setup already treated for sound. 

 Your Data & Privacy 

 Before any session recording, you'll be asked to review and sign a Consent Form covering how your voice recordings are collected, used (including to train synthesized/AI voice models), shared with approved partners, retained, and how to exercise your data rights (access, correction, deletion, and more, depending on where you live). If you'd like to review these terms before applying, contact us and we'll share a copy in advance. 

 Compensation

 uPhone · Fully remote (work from anywhere) · Full-time · Apply to 
 Posted 18 November 2026 · Open until 17 January 2027
 Fully remote — work from anywhere in the world, with no country restriction. Compensation is competitive and negotiable based on experience.
 About uPhone
 uPhone is an eSIM marketplace built for modern travellers, available at (). The service is operated by Targa Limited, a company registered in Hong Kong. The team is small, remote-first, and based across Europe and Asia.
 uPhone was founded on a simple belief: staying connected abroad should not be expensive, complicated, or stressful. The company sources eSIM data plans from multiple suppliers across 150+ countries so travellers can get a fair price — without hidden fees, locked contracts, roaming charges, or the plastic waste of a physical SIM card.
 What uPhone eSIM is, in practice: an eSIM is a digital SIM profile built into the phone. Customers choose a country, regional, or global data plan (5,000+ plans are listed, including unlimited-data options and a Globetrotter plan covering 150+ countries on one eSIM), pay securely (card or PayPal; other methods, including crypto on the Crypto eSIM checkout, are listed on the site), and receive a QR code by email — typically within seconds. They scan it in iPhone or Android settings and can be connected in under two minutes, with no store visit. The physical SIM stays in the phone, so the home number remains available. Plans are data-only; calls and texts abroad are made over apps such as WhatsApp, FaceTime, or iMessage. Monthly and yearly plans are available for trips of 30 days or more. Plans are listed from about $2, with no contract.
 uPhone publishes 24/7 customer support via live chat and email (the help centre cites a typical response time under two minutes), a 30-day unused-eSIM refund if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated, and a rating of 4.8/5 from 50,000+ travellers who trust the service.
 Company values, as stated on the About Us page: transparency (what you see is what you pay), simplicity (purchase to connected in under two minutes), reliability (24/7 support and a clear refund policy), and sustainability (digital eSIMs mean zero plastic waste).
 The role
 We are hiring a Customer Service Manager to lead uPhone's support operation.
 Travellers contact us when they are about to fly, when they have just landed, or when a plan will not activate. The site promises 24/7 support by live chat and email, with a typical response time under two minutes, plus a clear 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy. Your job is to make that promise real: build and run the team, the coverage, the quality, and the processes behind it.
 This is a fully remote, full-time, player-coach role on a small team — you can work from anywhere in the world. You will handle complex cases yourself, coach agents, set standards, and feed traveller issues back to product and suppliers so the same problems are not answered twice.
 Responsibilities
 - Lead day-to-day customer service across live chat and email, including coverage planning for 24/7 support, on a small remote team.
 - Set and track service standards (response time, resolution time, quality, refund accuracy, and tone). Protect the published typical response time of under two minutes, or recommend an honest change if that standard cannot be met.
 - Coach and develop support staff, including onboarding, macros and quality reviews, feedback, and performance management, and contribute to hiring as the team grows.
 - Own the support knowledge base and macros so answers about installation, device compatibility, coverage, top-ups, refunds, and troubleshooting stay accurate as plans and policies change.
 - Handle and escalate complex cases: failed activations, APN or device issues, carrier locks, payment or refund disputes, and supplier outages — and make sure travellers are not left mid-trip without a path to a fix.
 - Apply the 30-day unused-eSIM refund policy consistently (full refund only if the QR code has not been scanned and the eSIM has not been installed or activated; installed or activated eSIMs are non-refundable even if no data was used), and flag edge cases.
 - Report volume, themes, and product or supplier issues to the rest of the team, and propose changes that reduce repeat contacts.
 - Use the team's live-chat, email, and knowledge-base tools to keep quality and reporting consistent.
 Requirements

 - Able to design rotas, quality standards, and simple processes that still work when the team is small and remote.

As a contractor, you’ll invoice us monthly and handle your own taxes and social security contributions. 

 ABOUT 3Y HEALTH 

 3Y Health is building the operating system for healthcare practices, an AI-native platform that helps clinicians start, run and grow their practice. We work as a managed services organization (MSO): along with the software, our operations team runs the back office for the clinics we partner with, including billing, insurance and compliance. We currently serve applied behavior analysis (ABA) therapy practices and are expanding into other specialties. We're backed by over $200mm from Founders Fund, General Catalyst, SoftBank and 8VC.

 We enter new markets by acquiring a foundational clinic for each specialty and region we go into, and we partner with independent clinics across the country. Every clinic adds entities, filings, contracts, staff records and deadlines that need to stay in order.

 In this role, you'll own a set of our entities from start to finish. When we acquire a clinic, you'll carry out its integration plan: collect and file the records, prepare the filings, get staff ready for day one and follow up with everyone until each item is closed. Each deal comes with a detailed plan and timeline from the deal lead. Acquired clinics keep running largely as they do today until we bring them onto our platform, usually within a few months. Once a clinic is integrated, you'll keep its entity in good standing, alongside the existing entities you own.

 You don't need experience in US healthcare. Every deal comes with a detailed checklist, and we'll teach you the US specifics. You need to learn fast, care about details and follow through.  Work through each deal's integration checklist from before signing through the first months after close, keep the tracker current, and flag anything at risk of slipping

 Document how the clinic runs today, such as scheduling, intake, referrals and billing handoffs

 Check that each acquired entity is in good standing, and that its legal name and tax ID match across IRS, state, bank and payer records

- 
 Support our team and advisors on payer change-of-ownership notices, Medicare enrollment updates and credentialing checks

 Entity management and corporate operations

 Maintain entity records, including formation documents, officers, registered agents and ownership

- 
 Prepare and submit provider and facility enrollments with state Medicaid programs and other public payers, and track them to approval

- 
 Note what worked and what didn't, so our checklists get better with each deal

 At Vynca, our mission is to provide comprehensive care for more quality days at home.

 About the job 

 We are seeking a dedicated Lead Care Manager (LCM) to join our team. Reporting to the Director of Enhanced Care Management, ECM Clinical Manager, and/or ECM Program Manager, the LCM serves as the primary coordinator for clients, partnering with healthcare providers, specialists, pharmacists, social service agencies, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless, person-centered care. The LCM manages client cases, coordinates health care benefits, provides education and facilitates member access to care in a timely and cost-effective manner. The LCM collaborates and communicates with client’s caregivers/family support persons, other providers and others in the Care Team in order to promote wellness, recovery, independence, resilience, and member empowerment, while ensuring access to appropriate services and maximizing member benefit. 

 Internal Title: Lead Care Manager 

 At this time we are only considering applicants in the following states: California*, Arizona, Colorado, Illinois, Nevada, Oregon, Texas, Utah and Washington. 

 *Applicants based in California must be bilingual with the ability to fluently speak in two or more languages as needed. Bilingual in Spanish is highly preferred. 

 Vynca hires for this role on an ongoing basis throughout the year. This posting stays open because we regularly have openings for the Lead Care Manager role, but we don’t have a fixed start date or hiring timeline. We review applications as positions become available, and not every applicant will be contacted right away. Submitting an application doesn’t guarantee an interview or offer. If your background strongly matches a current or upcoming opening, a member of our team will reach out. Applications may be kept on file for 6 months for future openings. 

 What you’ll do 

 Remote care management duties as described below: 

- 
 Assess member needs in the areas of physical health, mental health, SUD, oral health, palliative care, memory care, trauma-informed care, social supports, housing, and referral and linkage to community-based services and supports 

- 
 Oversees the development of the client care plans and goal settings 

- 
 Offer services where the member resides, seeks care, or finds most easily accessible, including office-based, telehealth, or field-based services 

- 
 Connect clients to other social services and supports that are needed 

- 
 Advocate on behalf of the client with health care professionals (e.g. PCP, etc.)

- 
 Utilize evidence-based practices, such as Motivational Interviewing, Harm Reduction, and Trauma-Informed Care principles 

- 
 Conduct outreach and engagement activities in order to facilitate linkage to the ECM program and log activity in the Client Relationship Management (CRM) system

 Evaluate client’s progress and update SMART goals

 Provide mental health promotion 

- 
 Arrange transportation (e.g., ACCESS) 

- 
 Complete all documentation, including outcome measures within the timeframes established by the individual care plans

- 
 Complete monthly reporting to ensure program compliance 

- 
 Attend training as assigned

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical Product Owner (Contractor) for two AI Pods that build the foundations of Numa, Enumerate ’s AI product line, including Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist. This role is focused on execution, not product strategy or roadmap direction. The Product Owner will own and detail the AI Pod backlog, lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for every release, document test findings clearly, and analyze customer usage and metrics to inform what gets built next. The role reports to the Director of Product Management and works closely with Product Managers and Engineering. This is a strong fit for someone with a QA background who has recently moved into a product role and wants to grow in product management working on live, customer-facing AI products.

 This is a remote contractor opportunity for candidates located in LATAM who are comfortable working in an English-speaking professional environment. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Backlog Ownership & Agile Execution

- Own, detail, and manage the delivery backlog for the two AI Pod teams

- Translate defined product priorities into detailed user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria

- Break down initiatives into well-scoped epics, stories, and tasks with clear definitions of ready and done

- Keep backlog items refined, prioritized, and ready for development ahead of each sprint

- Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners whose features depend on the AI Pods to validate requirements and sign-off

- Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, refinement, reviews, and retrospectives

- Partner with Engineering to clarify scope, remove blockers, and escalate dependencies and risks

 User Acceptance Testing & Quality Validation

- Plan and conduct UAT for AI Pod deliverables and provide release sign-off

- Create and maintain UAT plans, test scenarios, and test cases tied to acceptance criteria

- Perform functional, regression, and edge-case testing on completed stories and features before release

- Validate AI output quality for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including accuracy, relevance, consistency, and exception handling, using repeatable test prompts and evaluation sets

- Log, document, and prioritize defects, and verify fixes before closing

 Documentation of Findings

- Document UAT results, defects, and AI output evaluation findings in a clear, structured, repeatable format

- Produce release-level test summaries covering what was tested, results, known issues, and recommended follow-ups

- Maintain up-to-date user stories, acceptance criteria, test cases, and supporting documentation

- Provide Product Marketing with feature details and release information needed for go-to-market materials

 Customer Usage & Metrics Analysis

- Own product analytics for Ask Numa and Homeowner Assist, including adoption, usage, and engagement metrics

- Analyze usage patterns, customer questions, and feedback to identify friction points, gaps in AI responses, and improvement opportunities

- Build and maintain recurring usage and metrics reporting for product leadership

- Turn findings into backlog items and use data to inform prioritization

 AI & Automation Workflow Enablement

- Analyze and document end-to-end workflows suitable for AI-driven automation

- Turn tasks users currently perform manually into clear requirements Engineering can build from

- Define business rules, inputs, outputs, dependencies, and exception handling

- Ensure workflows are well-documented and testable

 Required Qualifications 

- Background in QA or software testing (manual and/or automated), with recent hands-on experience (roughly 1–3 years) as a Product Owner, Associate Product Manager, or Business Analyst on a software product

- Strong UAT experience: writing test plans and test cases from acceptance criteria, executing functional, regression, and edge-case testing, and giving release sign-off

- Experience writing detailed user stories and testable acceptance criteria and managing a backlog in Jira or a similar tool within an Agile/Scrum team

- At least some hands-on experience with AI products, such as working on, testing, or supporting an LLM-powered assistant, chatbot, or AI feature

- Working understanding of LLMs, including why outputs vary, common failure modes such as hallucination and inconsistency, and how to test and evaluate AI output quality

- Analytical by nature: comfortable pulling and interpreting product usage data and turning findings into clear recommendations

- Clear, structured written documentation that others can act on without a walkthrough

- Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken

Enumerate is looking for a Staff Accountant to join our team! 

 As part of our goal to create and support the best community association management software, Enumerate offers accounting solutions for clients. As a Staff Accountant, you will be responsible for performing bank reconciliations and preparing financial statements for Enumerate’s Financial Services clients. This is a hands-on role that requires experience working in the HOA/COA industry. The ideal candidate has a strong attention to detail,, a passion for continuous improvement, and a proven ability to leverage technology to improve efficiency, quality, and business outcomes.

 This is a contractor engagement eligible to applicants located in LATAM. 

 Key Responsibilities 

- Manage the monthly close: Record and review journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other adjustments; meet established close deadlines. 

- Reconcile accounts: Reconcile bank accounts, balance sheet accounts, and supporting schedules; research and resolve discrepancies. 

- Oversee A/P and A/R accuracy: Review transaction coding, payment activity, owner balances, deposits, and receivables for accuracy and proper supporting documentation. 

- Prepare financial statements: Produce and review monthly financial packages, including the balance sheet, income statement, general ledger, and supporting schedules. 

- Analyze financial results: Compare actual results to budget, identify unusual variances, and provide clear explanations to clients and management. 

- Maintain accurate records: Ensure transactions are posted to the correct association, account, and period, with complete documentation and an audit trail. 

- Support annual budgets and audits: Assist with budget preparation, audit requests, year-end schedules, and other client reporting needs.

- Follow controls and procedures: Apply EFS policies, client-specific requirements, and approval controls; escalate risks, errors, or recurring process issues. 

- Manage portfolio deadlines: Track deliverables across assigned communities and communicate early when information or action is needed to complete work on time. 

 Qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting/appropriate field of study or comparable work experience 

- 3+ years of experience as a Staff Accountant

- Property management accounting experience is a bonus!

- Experience with creating financial statements, general ledger functions and the month-end/year end close process 

- Experience with accounting software

- Speed and accuracy are essential for this role which requires multiple financials prepared and issued daily

 Total monthly compensation:

 $2,700—$3,200 USD

We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

 We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who loves building clean, performant interfaces and knows their way around a CMS well enough to make the backend work for the frontend, not against it. You'll spend most of your time in HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript — building custom Gutenberg blocks, theming, and pixel-perfect implementations from design mockups — while staying comfortable enough in PHP and WordPress/Drupal internals to troubleshoot, extend, and integrate when needed.

 You'll work directly with our design and consulting teams to turn mockups into fast, accessible, well-crafted websites for clients across a range of industries.

 What You'll Do

- 
 Build custom WordPress themes, Gutenberg blocks (ACF or React-based), and plugins from provided designs

 Translate mockups into responsive, accessible frontend code using HTML, CSS/SASS, and modern JavaScript

- 
 Work within Drupal for client sites that require it — theming, content types, and module-level troubleshooting

- 
 Diagnose and fix frontend and backend issues across a variety of CMS platforms

- 
 Collaborate directly with designers, consultants, and occasionally clients to solve problems and refine implementations

- 
 Use AI tools like Claude Code to plan out and execute aspects of a large project.

 What You Bring

 Must-haves 

- 
 5+ years of professional frontend development — strong HTML, CSS/SASS, and JavaScript fundamentals

- 
 3+ years building and customizing WordPress sites, including Gutenberg block development (ACF or React-based blocks)

- 
 Solid working knowledge of PHP (7.x/8.x) — enough to read, debug, and extend WordPress/Drupal codebases confidently

- 
 Practical Drupal experience — theming, content architecture, or module-level work

- 
 Familiarity with WordPress hooks/filters and general LAMP-stack conventions (MySQL, Git)

- 
 Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating in a remote, client-facing environment

- 
 Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude Code.

 Nice-to-haves 

- 
 Experience with React or Angular

- 
 Laravel or Symfony

- 
 Docker and Linux environment familiarity

- 
 AWS or other cloud platform exposure

 Why Brafton

 100% remote, full-time role with a US-based team lead and a genuinely collaborative, cross-office culture spanning five countries.

 Compensation

 Plus commission

 Additional Information

🚀 Be the First Conversation in Every Great Hire 

📍 Role: Bilingual Talent Acquisition Specialist / Interviewer (USD Contract) 
📍 Location: Mexico City, Mexico 06000
 Work From Home / Remote - LATAM 
 Latin America (Offshore), full-time, US hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

At Luminize , we help brands win. As a top 5 Amazon seller in the US by volume, we're growing fast, and great hiring starts with a great first screen.
 We are looking for a Candidate Screening Specialist to own the qualification step between application and recruiter. You will review inbound applicants, run structured screening interviews, and keep clean, consistent records in our applicant tracking system (ATS). You will screen for roles across our San Diego corporate team and our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. This is a focused role. Your job is to hold a consistent, fair bar across high volume screens so our recruiters spend their time on candidates who are truly ready.
 If you take pride in sound judgment, clear notes, and doing the details right every time, we would love to meet you!
 🎯 What You'll Be Doing 

- Review inbound applications and resumes against role requirements, keeping the applicant queue current with no aged applications

- Conduct structured phone and video screening interviews using an approved screening guide and scorecard

- Write concise, evidence-based screen notes in ATS, working from meeting transcripts

- Make advance or decline decisions at the screening stage, and apply an accurate reason code to every candidate you disposition

- Flag strong candidates who may fit a different open role, and escalate patterns such as off-profile applicants or screening guides that don't reflect the role

- Support general upkeep of the ATS so job posts, application questions, candidate emails, and reporting stay accurate

 🏆 What Success Looks Like 

- Recruiters consistently agree with the candidates you advance. Quality matters more than volume.

- Every applicant is reviewed promptly, and every screen is documented the same day

- Every dispositioned candidate carries a clear reason code, giving our team reliable hiring data

- Candidates leave your screen with an accurate picture of the role and a professional impression of Luminize 

 ✅ What You Bring 

- 3+ years recent experience conducting candidate screens and structured interviews

- US-market recent recruiting experience

- Fluent professional English required, written and spoken with the ability to build rapport quickly

- Experience with an ATS (i.e JazzHR)

- Familiarity with AI and video interview platforms (i.e. Fathom)

- Ability to assess candidates against a defined scorecard rather than personal impression, and to accept calibration feedback

- Working knowledge of EEO and non-discrimination principles in screening, including topics that should not be asked

- Concise written assessment skills: you document evidence, not impressions

- Strong attention to detail and the discipline to keep records accurate under time pressure

- Discretion with confidential candidate information

- Ability to work 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time, Monday through Friday

- Reliable high-speed internet with backup power, and a quiet workspace suitable for video interviews

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

 About Luminize 
 Luminize is a full-service Amazon growth partner helping brands succeed in a competitive digital marketplace. From creative strategy to advertising and analytics, we combine expertise and hustle to drive results for brands in CPG, health, wellness, beauty, and beyond.
 Luminize also operates as Coastal Trading Ventures (CTV), our warehouse and fulfillment operation in Fort Worth, Texas. CTV keeps products moving from the dock to the customer, giving us end-to-end control of the brand experience from listing to delivery.
 We are not your typical agency, and we like it that way. We operate with transparency, celebrate wins often, and treat every brand like it's our own.
 If you are ready to work with great people, do work that matters, and keep growing, we would love to meet you!
 👉 Apply now and let's grow together! 
 Luminize uses automated tools to help screen, rank, and filter applications as part of our hiring process. These tools help our recruiting team surface and organize candidate information. Final hiring decisions are made by our recruiters and hiring managers, not by the technology alone.
 You have the right to opt out of the use of this technology for your application. If you opt out, a member of our recruiting team will review your application manually. You also have the right to request information about how this technology was used in any decision about your application.
 To opt out or request more information, contact . We will not retaliate against you for exercising these rights.

 About Us
 HireHawk connects experienced professionals with U.S. companies building high-performing remote teams. For this opportunity, you will support a U.S.-based legal practice handling Personal Injury civil litigation, working closely with attorneys while taking meaningful ownership of day-to-day litigation support.
 About the Role
 We are looking for an experienced bilingual English-Spanish Civil Litigation Paralegal with hands-on California Personal Injury litigation experience. You will take substantial ownership of written discovery, communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients, prepare litigation documents, and help attorneys keep cases moving toward deadlines.
 This is role is for someone who already understands how California civil litigation works in practice. You should be comfortable handling routine litigation matters independently, identifying what information is missing, following up proactively, and knowing when an issue requires attorney review.
 The team values practical PI litigation knowledge, reliability, and work ethic more than having a minimal accent. Strong bilingual communication and the ability to get accurate information from clients matter most.
 Responsibilities

- Own the preparation, organization, and coordination of written discovery for California Personal Injury litigation matters.

- Prepare and support responses to interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery requests.

- Communicate directly with English- and Spanish-speaking clients to gather case facts, records, documents, and other information required for discovery.

- Review client responses and supporting documents, identify missing or incomplete information, and follow up until discovery packages are ready for attorney review.

- Draft and prepare pleadings and other routine civil litigation documents with limited supervision.

- Coordinate with attorneys to ensure discovery responses, pleadings, and supporting materials are complete, accurate, and submitted on time.

- Track California litigation deadlines, discovery due dates, court dates, and other case-related milestones.

- Prepare and coordinate California Superior Court filings and electronic filings.

- Organize medical records, supporting documents, client materials, and litigation files so attorneys can quickly access the information they need.

- Assist with motions and other litigation documentation when required while recognizing when attorney input or approval is necessary.

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Significant hands-on experience supporting U.S. Personal Injury civil litigation matters, including practical California litigation experience. 

- Strong working knowledge of California civil discovery procedures, workflows, and deadlines. 

- Demonstrated experience preparing interrogatories, requests for production, requests for admission, and related discovery responses. 

- Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken, with the confidence to communicate directly with Spanish-speaking clients about detailed case information. 

- Strong legal drafting and document-review skills, including experience preparing pleadings and supporting litigation documents. 

- Experience managing multiple active matters, competing deadlines, litigation calendars, and court filing requirements with a high degree of accuracy. 

- Ability to independently handle routine civil litigation work, proactively resolve missing information, and appropriately escalate substantive legal questions to attorneys. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Experience with California Superior Court electronic filing systems. 

- Experience using MerusCase or comparable litigation case management software; MerusCase experience is strongly preferred. 

- Paralegal certification or formal legal education. 

- Previous experience working remotely with U.S. attorneys or litigation teams. 

- Broader experience supporting motions and other pretrial litigation work.

This is a remote position.

 About the Company The client is a fast-growing permanent-capital holding company based in North Carolina, USA, that acquires, owns, and operates small businesses for the long term. Its current portfolio includes a variety of local service-based businesses—ranging from equipment dealerships to property and facility services—with additional acquisitions actively in progress. As the company continues to scale its portfolio of companies and team members, it is seeking a highly capable Executive Assistant to provide direct, high-level support to the Principal, helping ensure operations, commitments, and daily priorities run with structure, accountability, and efficiency. 
 About the Role The Executive Assistant is a high-ownership hybrid role combining executive support, operational coordination, and task management. This position works directly with the Principal, who operates at a fast pace and generates deals, ideas, and commitments quickly. The primary responsibility of this role is to be the system behind leadership: capturing commitments, managing calendars, triaging communication, and keeping day-to-day operations moving smoothly without letting details fall through the cracks. This is not a traditional administrative position focused solely on completing assigned tasks. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver who thinks independently, exercises sound judgment, identifies what needs to happen next, and takes full ownership of getting it done. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Executive Support & Calendar 

- Manage and protect executive calendars, meetings, and daily schedules, ensuring proper buffer times and priorities are maintained. 

- Prepare leadership for meetings by providing key context, summary notes, and relevant documentation. 

- Triage incoming communications, email, and messages daily, drafting responses and flagging priority items (targeting daily Inbox Zero). 

- Translate voice memos, phone calls, and verbal commitments into written follow-ups, action items, and clear records on the same day. 

 Operations & Project Follow-Through 

- Maintain a centralized system to track open commitments, deadlines, and action items across internal teams and external parties. 

- Proactively follow up with stakeholders to ensure tasks and projects are completed on time. 

- Pre-read long documents, reports, and contracts to provide concise summaries and recommendations. 

- Support administrative coordination across residential and commercial property management, vendor communication, and invoice tracking. 

- Handle personal and administrative management, including subscriptions, vendor scheduling, and key document organization in shared drives. 

 Communication & Logistics 

- Coordinate equipment, vehicle servicing, orders, and deliveries remotely by phone and email through local teams. 

- Plan end-to-end travel logistics, including flights, transportation, lodging, and itineraries. 

- Serve as a clear, calm, and professional point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. 

 Technology & Systems 

- Build and maintain organized systems across Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) and Slack. 

- Leverage AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to research, summarize, draft communications, and improve operational productivity while verifying data accuracy. 

- Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and automate repetitive administrative work.

 Requirements

- Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, or similar high-ownership support role for founders or senior executives. 

- Broad generalist background with the ability to comfortably manage diverse and shifting tasks. 

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills (Spanish fluency is a valuable asset). 

- Strong organizational, systems-building, and project tracking abilities with high attention to detail. 

- Proactive self-starter mindset with demonstrated ability to operate independently with minimal supervision. 

- Direct, calm, and confident communication style when interacting with fast-moving executives and teams. 

- High degree of discretion when handling confidential business, administrative, and personal information. 

- Tech-savvy with proficiency in Google Workspace, Slack, and AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT). 

 Technical Skills 
 Experience with the following tools is highly valued: 

- Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets) 

- Slack 

- AI Productivity Tools (Claude, ChatGPT) 

- Task-tracking and project management tools

 Benefits

- Salary: $1,400 - $1,800 

- Growth opportunity: Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing company and take on increasing responsibility over time. 

- Location: LATAM.

vacantes.descripcion:
Ranking Copilot is a fast-growing software company used by law firms to prepare their legal directory submissions (Chambers, Legal 500, IFLR and others) and their pitches and proposals. Firms keep their matters, lawyers, clients and referees in one place and produce better submissions and pitches in far less time. Our clients are law firms in the UK, Europe and the US.
 This is a full-time, fully remote contractor role. We especially welcome people based in South America, Central America or Asia. Hours are mostly UK and European business hours, with some US overlap. We are flexible on the exact schedule as long as clients get calls in their working day.
 The role
 You will be the main contact for a set of law firm clients, from their first day to renewal.

- Onboard new firms: run kick-off calls, help them get their data in, and train their marketing and BD teams.

- Run regular check-in calls and answer day-to-day questions by email and chat.

- Spot firms that are not using the product and get them back on track before deadlines.

- Collect feedback and bugs, and pass them clearly to the product team.

- Own renewals for your accounts and flag expansion opportunities.

- Write short help articles and how-to guides.

 What we are looking for

- Native or native-level English, written and spoken. You will write to and speak with partners and marketing directors at law firms every day.

- At least 2 years of experience in customer support or a similar client-facing role, ideally at a B2B software company.

- Confident on video calls with senior professionals.

- Organised and reliable without supervision. We are a small remote team.

- Stable internet and a quiet place to take calls.

- Nice to have: experience with law firms, legal marketing or legal directories; HubSpot or Intercom.

 What you get

- Fixed monthly pay of USD 1,500 - 1,800, depending on experience.

- Shares in the company for people who perform well.

- Fully remote, flexible schedule.

- Direct work with the founders and real influence on the product.

 How to apply
 Please send:

- Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

- A 2-minute video (Loom is fine) telling us where you are based and why this role suits you.

- The hours you can work, in UK time.

About FreedUp 

 FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.
 About the role
 We're looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to be the "second brain" for a fast-moving US entrepreneur. He runs a growing private aircraft sales business, where many leads come in through his social media content, and he co-owns a pool services company.
 You'll own his CRM, keep his sales team on track, stay on top of his calendar, files and travel, and help with the personal details that make life run smoothly. You won't just follow instructions: he wants someone who audits how things are done, spots gaps without being told, and suggests what to hand off next. This is a behind-the-scenes role. He handles all client calls and onboarding himself.
 Compensation: 1,000 to 1,700 USD (Depends on Experience)
 Location: Remote, LATAM
 Job Type: Full-time
 What you'll do
 1. Own the Notion CRM (ramps up gradually)

- Keep the aviation sales pipeline watertight: deal stages, last-contact dates and next steps always current.

- Add new and missing deals, including aircraft that go under contract, and flag stale records (for example, "last contact was months ago").

- After each recorded sales Zoom call, use the transcript and Claude to create the CRM entry with the contact's details, write next steps and delegate follow-ups to the right sales rep.

- Take over the CRM step by step as you learn the nuances of the business.

 2. Coordinate the sales team

- Follow up with the two sales reps so they stay on top of their leads and keep their deals updated in the CRM, without adding extra admin work to their plate.

- Make sure every deal has clear next steps and that aircraft listings get the visibility they need.

- Send him consolidated status overviews so he can see the whole pipeline at a glance.

 3. Manage Dropbox filing (from day one)

- Move aircraft photos, videos, spec sheets, sales brochures, maintenance status reports, contracts, LOIs, APAs and deposit confirmations from email into the right Dropbox folders as soon as they arrive.

- Follow a clear SOP and keep everything consistent as the team grows. Much of this material is sensitive or client-facing, so accuracy matters.

 4. Manage his calendar and reminders

- Manage his Outlook calendar and his availability for calls booked through Calendly.

- Handle reschedule requests and send short scheduling emails to clients when needed.

- Send a proactive end-of-day "here's tomorrow" text with his meetings, addresses, links, documents or waivers to sign, and anything he needs to bring, plus a suggested time for his daily workout around a busy schedule.

 5. Book travel

- Plan two to three mostly domestic trips a month, comparing options on Kayak and booking through airline apps.

- Follow his saved preferences: direct flights, no very early departures and exit row seats, with his traveler details on file.

- Handle booking, check-in and confirmations so everything is ready on his phone.

 6. Handle personal and admin tasks

- Take care of waivers, vehicle registrations and other paperwork for his trucks and businesses.

- Remember birthdays and anniversaries, and arrange flowers and gifts for his wife and kids within a set budget.

- Process payroll for his pool company (about six people).

- Possibly monitor GoHighLevel for new pool leads during your working hours and send quick text replies.

 Please note: this role does not include client calls or onboarding. He handles all client conversations himself. Beyond these tasks, he wants you to audit his systems, spot the low-hanging fruit and tell him what else you can take off his plate.
 Our hiring process

- Apply online

- Record a short Loom video introducing yourself/ Prescreen call with a recruiter

- Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead

- Complete a work evaluation

- Final interview with the client

 Requirements
 Must-haves

- At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Coordinator or in a similar support role.

- A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented.

- Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.

- Disciplined and professional.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Comfortable handling both business and personal tasks.

- High discretion with client, financial and payroll information.

- Available full-time from 9 AM to 5 PM US Central Time.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

 Nice-to-haves

- A good sense of humor and a likable personality.

- Experience with Notion as a CRM.

- Comfort using AI tools, especially Claude.

- Sales operations or high-ticket sales support

All candidates from LATAM are welcome to apply!!! 

- 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

- 
 Workplace: Remote

- 
 Compensation: USD $1,500 - $1,700 / month

- 
 Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM Pacific Time

 About Us
 HireHawk connects experienced professionals with U.S. companies that value expertise, reliability, and meaningful contributions. We're recruiting on behalf of an established boutique plaintiff personal injury law firm in Los Angeles with a team of more than 30 professionals. The firm focuses heavily on premises liability cases against commercial businesses, building strong claims and pursuing the full value of every case.
 About the Role
 We're looking for a Personal Injury Case Manager (Pre-Litigation) who can independently manage an assigned portfolio of California personal injury cases from day one.
 You'll take ownership of case progression, client communication, medical treatment coordination, insurance follow-ups, and pre-litigation preparation. You'll work directly with attorneys, paralegals, legal assistants, and case manager assistants to ensure cases are thoroughly developed and positioned for resolution.
 This is a hands-on position for someone who already understands U.S. personal injury case management. The firm expects you to work independently with minimal supervision and does not provide foundational training for remote hires.
 Responsibilities

- Own an assigned portfolio of California pre-litigation personal injury cases, ensuring claims progress toward resolution and critical deadlines are met.

- Keep clients informed and engaged throughout their cases, providing empathetic updates and consistent follow-through on medical treatment and next steps.

- Coordinate with medical providers to help clients attend appointments, complete recommended treatment, and follow through on MRIs, injections, and specialist care.

- Review medical records, monitor treatment progress, and identify gaps in care, missing documentation, or issues that could weaken or delay a claim.

- Communicate with insurance adjusters to obtain claim updates, complete policy searches, verify coverage, and document bodily injury and commercial liability policy limits.

- Identify potential liability issues, treatment delays, and settlement obstacles, resolving routine matters independently and escalating legal concerns to attorneys when appropriate.

- Direct case manager assistants responsible for scheduling medical appointments and requesting medical records and billing documentation.

- Maintain accurate, organized, and up-to-date case files using the firm's case management software and remote-access systems.

- Collaborate with attorneys, paralegals, and legal assistants on medical liens, demand preparation, and pre-litigation settlement efforts.

- Prioritize competing case needs and maintain consistent follow-ups so cases do not stall due to missed appointments, outstanding records, or unresolved insurance matters.

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Proven hands-on experience independently managing U.S. personal injury cases through the pre-litigation process, with the ability to contribute immediately without foundational training. 

- Practical knowledge of California personal injury claims, liability evaluation, insurance procedures, and pre-litigation settlement processes. 

- Fluent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S. clients, medical providers, and insurance representatives. 

- Experience coordinating medical treatment, including MRIs, injections, and follow-up care, as well as reviewing medical records and identifying treatment gaps. 

- Strong working knowledge of bodily injury insurance claims, policy searches, coverage verification, and policy limits, including commercial liability coverage. 

- Familiarity with medical liens, demand preparation, settlement workflows, and knowing when an issue requires attorney involvement. 

- Strong caseload management, organization, and deadline-tracking skills, with experience using legal case management software and working independently in a remote environment. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Experience handling California premises liability claims, particularly slip-and-fall and trip-and-fall cases involving commercial properties. 

- Experience preparing attorney-ready case summaries, medical chronologies, or demand-support packages. 

- Familiarity with remote desktop systems used to access U.S. law firm software and case files. 

- Experience coordinating or overseeing case manager assistants in a personal injury practice.

You will play a key role in managing accounts receivable, accounts payable coordination, collections communication, and payment processing across multiple related entities within our freight and transportation operations. - Assist the accounting department with applying and reconciling customer payments accurately across multiple entities

- Experience in Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), collections, bookkeeping, or accounting support roles

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines confidently

- Experience using QuickBooks, Intuit Enterprise products, or similar accounting systems

- Ability to handle customer and vendor communications with professionalism, respect, and attention to detail

- Self-starter mentality with strong follow-up habits and accountability

- Comfortable working remotely and collaborating through Microsoft Teams and other communication tools

- Experience working in logistics, freight, transportation, or multi-entity business environments is a plus

 Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with transportation management systems (TMS)

- Prior experience supporting U.S.-based companies remotely

- Familiarity with credit reporting and collections processes

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

 Company Culture

vacantes.descripcion:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

 With over 70 clinics across 9 states , and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

 We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93 , the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

 This is not a generic sales role.
 We’re hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) - internally named, Patient Intake Coordinator, with experience in medical call centers, front desk patient scheduling, or insurance-based sales . You’ll serve as the first voice a patient hears , managing phone conversations with empathy and urgency while verifying insurance, overcoming objections, and securing appointments across our 60+ clinics. As a Patient Intake Coordinator , your mission is to connect with prospective patients, bring clarity to their symptoms and treatment options, and confidently guide them to book a vein evaluation and ultrasound. You are the frontline driver of new patient growth, ensuring every interaction is patient-first, educational, and action-oriented.
 Success in this role requires a deep understanding of healthcare workflows , confidence navigating insurance barriers , and prior experience converting calls into booked visits .
 If you’ve worked in a medical practice, urgent care center, or dental front desk—and know how to guide patients, ask the right questions, and document accurately in EMRs—this is for you. 
 Language Skills 
We are now accepting applications for bilingual, English / Spanish speaking candidates only.
 Compensation
 Independent Contractors (Latin America only)

- 
 $1,500 USD per month base compensation, paid bi-weekly
 Compensation structure is based on employment classification and work location. 

- 
 Schedule: Full-time | Includes evenings and one weekend day 

 What You’ll Do 

- Serve as the first point of contact for new patient leads

- Proactively connect with patients via inbound and outbound phone calls , email, and text

- Build rapport, answer questions, and guide patients to book consultations at over 60 nationwide clinics

- Communicate insurance coverage and payment options clearly to minimize booking barriers

- Verify insurance, initiate authorization requests, and manage CRM/EMR documentation

- Troubleshoot patient concerns and tailor your messaging to improve conversion rates (CVR) 

- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless handoff to clinical care

- Continuously refine your approach based on feedback and performance data

 What Success Looks Like
 Your performance will be measured by:

- 
 Activity & Productivity: Maintain high engagement by making and taking up to 100 calls per day.

- 
 Appointment Booking: Consistently book 10 to 15 evaluations with an ultrasound (U/S) per day.

- 
 Conversion Performance: Achieve a 55%+ conversion rate on qualified calls.

- 
 Operational Excellence: Deliver a consistent, patient-first experience aligned with QA guidelines and document 100% of interactions accurately in CRM/EMR systems.

- Speed and efficiency in response times and follow-up

- Patient satisfaction scores (NPS, direct feedback)

 What You’ll Bring 

- 
 Drive & Resilience: A competitive work ethic and a "productivity mindset". You should be energized by scoreboards and metrics, with a high resilience to rejection.

- 
 Sales Execution: Strong persuasion and objection-handling skills. You are comfortable "controlling a conversation" and moving a patient from initial interest to a scheduled visit.

- 
 Operational Discipline: The ability to navigate multiple tools (CRM, EMR, and phone systems) simultaneously with high attention to detail under pressure.

- 
 Coachability: A commitment to growth, with the ability to act on coaching and feedback quickly to improve performance.

- 
 Background Preference: Experience in sales (e.g., cold calling) or high-volume service environments (e.g., military or hospitality) is highly valued.

- Bilingual in Spanish is a requirement

 Requirements

- Based in Latin America and working as an independent contractor (this role is not open to US-based applicants)

- Fluent in English and Spanish for live patient calls

- Available full time on US time zone hours, including evenings and one weekend day

- Your own computer, noise-cancelling headset, webcam, reliable high-speed internet and a quiet, private workspace

 How to Apply
 Submit your resume and answer the application questions. Qualified applicants are invited to a short one-way video interview on HireFlix, answered in English and Spanish.

 The Metro Vein Centers Difference

 Healthy legs. Happier lives. 
At Metro Vein Center

 Are you a highly motivated logistics professional with experience in specialized freight? We are looking for a solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join an established, family-owned freight brokerage with a clear path to becoming a commission-earning Account Manager!

 🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗 

 🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH. 

 📋 Job Details at a Glance 

- Job Title: Bilingual Logistics Coordinator

- Job ID: FRAPAM2R

- Industry: Freight Brokerage and Logistics

- Location: LATAM

- Job Status: Full Time

- Work Schedule: Thursday - Monday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (EST) (Tuesday & Wednesday off) 

- Salary: $1500 per month

- Target Start Date: ASAP

 🏢 About the Client 

 Our client is an established, family-owned logistics service provider and freight brokerage dedicated to empowering commerce through efficient and innovative supply chain solutions. Built on a foundation of integrity, sustainability, and long-term relationships, they operate as a deeply trusted partner for businesses across multiple sectors.
 They pride themselves on a culture of constant communication and total transparency, providing 24/7 round-the-clock service to ensure time-sensitive freight is delivered seamlessly. By blending industry experience with personalized care, they provide an agile, fast-paced environment where employees are empowered to grow and directly contribute to the success of global trade.
 💼 About the Role 

 We are seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented Bilingual Logistics Coordinator to join our team. In this role, you will start with a strong focus on tracking, tracing, and operational execution, with a clear trajectory to advance into a commission-earning Account Manager role.
 The ideal candidate possesses exceptional customer service, problem-solving abilities, and a basic foundation in logistics operations. Rather than general freight, this role prioritizes experience in specialized freight sectors, specifically Produce and Open Deck (Oversize, Overweight, and Overwidth) cargo.
 🎯 Key Responsibilities 

- Track & Trace: Provide high-level track and trace coverage, ensuring real-time shipment visibility and accurate system updates.

- Issue Resolution: Proactively problem-solve operational hurdles during weekend and peak-season shifts to prevent delivery delays.

- Carrier Coordination: Maintain accurate communication with carriers regarding load specifics, pickup/delivery addresses, and schedule adherence.

- Market Pricing: Learn and adapt to market pricing platforms to effectively quote and negotiate competitive rates with open-deck and produce carriers.

- Role Advancement: Smoothly transition from an internal operations support position to a client-facing account management role based on performance.

 📈 Tiered Career Path 

- Tier C (Entry / Track & Trace): Focuses heavily on track and trace, answering driver calls, verifying pickup details, and providing proactive client updates.

- Tier B (Operations Specialist): Introduces market-rate quoting, carrier sourcing, and carrier rate negotiations.

- Tier A / S (Account Manager): Full management of key clients, independent quoting, and carrier book management. At this stage, the role transitions to a Monday–Friday schedule.

 ✅ Qualifications & Skills 

 ⭐ Core Requirements:

- Bilingual: Fluent in both Spanish and English (Required).

- Core Experience: 1–2 years of experience in track and trace, logistics coordination, or a freight brokerage setting.

- Niche Expertise: Proven experience or strong familiarity handling Produce and/or Open Deck (Oversize / Overweight / Overwidth) freight is highly preferred.

- Competencies: Strong negotiation skills, confident telephone demeanor, and excellent multi-tasking capabilities.

- Problem-Solving: Strong customer service mentality with the capacity to stay calm and resourceful under high-pressure, peak-season conditions.

 💻 Systems & Software:

- Experience with Load Boards (DAT, Truckstop) is strongly preferred.

- Experience with Transportation Management Systems (specifically Tai Software) is strongly preferred.

- Experience with 3CX dialer systems is a plus.

 🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity! 
 🌎 ATTENTION LATAM CANDIDATES: Join our exclusive Facebook community just for LATAM job seekers to get more updates and remote opportunities: 🔗 Join our LATAM Facebook Group Here!

 About the Role
 As a Bilingual Dental Virtual Assistant, you’ll take ownership of high-volume patient outreach, insurance verification, appointment scheduling, and follow-up across both dental offices. Outbound calling is the core of this position, so you should genuinely enjoy speaking with patients and be comfortable spending much of your workday on the phone.
 Your immediate priorities will include verifying insurance, scheduling six-month recall appointments, following up with patients, and completing postoperative care calls. As you build trust and demonstrate strong performance, you’ll have the opportunity to take on marketing lead follow-up and potentially grow into treatment coordination or broader dental administrative responsibilities.
 Responsibilities

- Own a consistent outbound calling workflow for patient recalls, appointment confirmations, postoperative follow-ups, and other priority outreach.

- Verify dental insurance eligibility and coverage before appointments by contacting insurance providers and patients as needed.

- Follow up with patients to collect missing or incomplete insurance information and keep records accurate and up to date.

- Re-engage patients who are due or overdue for six-month checkups and cleanings and help convert outreach into scheduled appointments.

- Confirm upcoming appointments and coordinate accurate scheduling across both dental office locations.

- Complete postoperative care calls, document patient feedback, and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate dental team.

- Maintain clear, accurate call notes, insurance verification results, appointment updates, and follow-up records in the practice’s systems.

- Track outbound call activity, talk time, completed follow-ups, and other performance expectations consistently.

- Coordinate closely with office managers and administrative staff to keep patient communication organized across both practices.

- After training, follow up with prospective patients generated through Meta/Facebook campaigns, answer general questions, and help convert interested leads into attended appointments

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Fluent spoken English and Spanish with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and empathetically with patients. 

- Experience in a dental, medical, patient coordination, reception, virtual assistant, or healthcare administrative environment. 

- Confidence performing high-volume outbound calling throughout the workday. 

- Experience scheduling patient appointments and maintaining accurate follow-up records. 

- Strong attention to detail when documenting patient conversations, insurance information, and scheduling updates. 

- Ability to handle confidential patient information appropriately and follow HIPAA requirements. 

- Hands-on experience with dental insurance verification, eligibility checks, and benefit confirmation. 

- Experience with outbound lead follow-up, appointment setting, or supporting a U.S.-based dental or medical practice remotely. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Familiarity with dental practice management software. 

- Experience using RingCentral or another web-based VoIP phone system..

All candidates from LATAM are welcome to apply!!! 

- 
 Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

- 
 Workplace: Remote

- 
 Compensation: USD $900 - $1,200 / month

- 
 Schedule: Monday-Friday schedule, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.

 About Us
 HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies that value ownership, reliability, and meaningful remote work. For this opportunity, you will support a pediatric dental practice in Texas that wants every family interaction to feel warm, personal, and well cared for. HireHawk offers a fully remote environment, structured onboarding, clear expectations, and an outcomes-first culture. 
 About the Role
 We are looking for a full-time Dental Scheduling Virtual Assistant who has proven experience scheduling outstanding treatment plans and re-care appointments in a dental practice.
 This is not a passive administrative role. Your primary goal is to proactively work the practice's outstanding patient lists, connect with families, and turn follow-up opportunities into booked appointments.
 You will have direct access to the practice's cloud-based dental software and internet phone system and will work closely with the practice owner and two front-office coordinators. Success will be visible in the numbers: quality outreach, completed follow-ups, and patients successfully added to the schedule.
 Responsibilities

- Own the daily outreach process for outstanding treatment plans and overdue re-care patients from report to booked appointment.

- Pull and work outstanding treatment and re-care reports from the practice management system every working day.

- Complete an initial target of 40-60 quality outbound call attempts per day while maintaining a warm, patient-focused experience.

- Follow up consistently with patients who do not book on the first attempt instead of allowing opportunities to fall through the cracks.

- Schedule outstanding treatment and re-care appointments accurately based on practice availability and patient needs.

- Use the practice's internet-based phone system so outbound calls appear to come directly from the dental office.

- Maintain a clear daily activity report covering patients contacted, re-care appointments scheduled, and outstanding treatment plans scheduled.

- Keep outreach lists organized and make it easy for the practice owner to see progress and results.

- Participate in regular update meetings with the practice owner and two front-office coordinators.

- Represent the pediatric practice with the same friendly, professional, and family-focused communication patients would receive from the in-office team.

 Requirements

 Must-Have: 

- Proven dental-office experience scheduling outstanding treatment plans and re-care or recall appointments from practice management reports. 

- A demonstrated track record of turning outbound patient follow-up into booked appointments. 

- Confidence completing 40-60 quality outbound call attempts per day and following patients consistently until there is a clear outcome. 

- Ability to work full-time Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time, and start as soon as possible. 

- Comfort learning and working independently in cloud-based dental practice management software and internet phone systems. 

- Reliable home-office setup with backup internet and power, plus willingness to participate in HireHawk 's standard activity monitoring during working hours. 

 Nice to Have: 

- Experience using Curve Dental Software 

- Experience with another dental practice management platform if you have not used Curve Dental.

Category: Health Care 

Location: 

 Position: Sales Patient Coordinator (High Value Cases)

 Company: Medical Departures Inc.
 Department: Medical Team

- USD 800 - 1,100 per month + Commission + Performance Bonuses

- 100% Remote — LATAM / APAC / EU

- Full-time Contractor | 5 days/week | 10 hours/day included lunch break l Shifts

 About Us
 Medical Departures Inc. is the world’s largest online platform for booking trusted global doctors and dentists — with 10,000+ professionals across 6,000+ clinics in 30 countries.
 We help patients find high-quality, affordable care abroad through our platforms:DentalDepartures.comandMedicalDepartures.com.
 Our fully remote team of 36+ professionals spans Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa — united by one mission: to make medical travel simpler, safer, and smarter.
 About the Role
 We are hiring high-performance sales professionals who can convert complex, high-value dental cases ($3,000–$25,000+) into confirmed and attended bookings.
 This is NOT short-cycle commodity sales.
 This is:

- Long follow-up cycles

- Emotional trust-based selling

- High-ticket consultation sales

- Travel-readiness qualification

- Attendance-driven execution

 You will be responsible not just for booking — but for ensuring patients SHOW UP.
 If you thrive in structured sales funnels, disciplined follow-up systems, and high accountability environments — this role is for you.
 What You’ll Do

 Big-Ticket Conversion (Primary Focus) 

- Convert inbound and outbound high-value leads into qualified, deposit-ready bookings.

- Execute structured follow-up sequences (minimum required touchpoints).

- Handle objections around:

- Price

- Travel

- Fear

- Clinic credibility

- Position treatment packages, brochures, and custom quotes professionally.

- Drive patient commitment toward deposit and confirmed attendance.

 Long-Cycle Follow-Up Discipline 

- Maintain consistent follow-up across sales cycles.

- No lead left untouched.

- Recycle dormant big-ticket leads strategically.

- Avoid premature “Not Interested” tagging without qualification attempts.

 Pre-Attendance Qualification 

 Before a booking is accepted as confirmed, you must validate:

- Treatment intent

- Financial readiness

- Timeline commitment

 You will work with Team Leaders to ensure bookings are not soft or forecast-inflating.

 Attendance Ownership 

- Proactively manage pre-VIP communication.

- Confirm travel details, deposits, and readiness.

- Reduce no-show rates.

- Protect clinic relationships by ensuring booking integrity.

 Pipeline & CRM Discipline 

- Maintain 95%+ CRM accuracy.

- 
 Track every stage:

 Lead → Contact → Qualified → Booked → Attended

- No ghosting, no abandoned big-ticket opportunities.

- Follow reassignment and performance-based distribution rules.

 Performance Expectations 

 This is a performance-driven role.
 You will be measured on:

- Big-ticket conversion rate

- Follow-up compliance

- Booking quality

- Attendance rate

- Revenue generated

- CRM accuracy

 Top performers receive:

- Priority access to high-value leads

- Promotion eligibility (Senior / Closer / Team Lead)

 Underperformance leads to reduced big-ticket allocation.
 Team Collaboration

- Join coaching sessions, performance reviews, and weekly team syncs.

- Participate in sales challenges and contribute to team targets.

 Ready to Join the Global Dental Revolution?
 Be part of a team that helps patients worldwide access affordable, high-quality care.
Apply now help us build the world’s largest global medical marketplace.

 Requirements

 Who You Are:

- >5 years of sales experience (ideally in healthcare, travel or remote B2C sales)

- Proven experience closing $3,000+ ticket deals

- Comfortable handling long-cycle sales

- Disciplined follow-up executor

- Comfortable being audited on performance

- Resilient under rejection and objections

- Fluent English (written + verbal)

- Confident using CRM systems (Zoho, Salesforce, etc.) and multitasking across tools (chat, phone, email)

- Comfortable working weekends (Saturday-Sunday) and flexible shifts

- Reliable, organized, and proactive in a fully remote setup

 Strongly Preferred 

- Medical / dental tourism experience

- Experience selling packages or bundled services

 Benefits

 What We Offer: 

- Guarantee base: Fixed monthly salary paid in USD

- Commission: 5% of all earned commissions

- Bonuses: Tiered monthly rewards ($100–$1,000) + team bonuses

- Incentives: Top performers win all-inclusive trips to global destinations

**PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ** 
 Location : Remote – Latin America
 Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
 Employment Type: Contractor, Full-Time
 Compensation: USD 1,100 per month
 English Proficiency: Strong professional English required
 About the Company
 Our client is an outdoor advertising company driven by the vision that great advertising isn't just seen, it's remembered. Based in New York, with affiliate offices in Milwaukee, the company specializes in the development, acquisition, and management of premium signage in major U.S. markets, including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Las Vegas, and Milwaukee.
 About the Role
 We are looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Sales Coordinator to support the day-to-day administration of the sales process.
 In this role, you will work closely with the National Account Executives to keep pre- and post-sale activities running smoothly, from proposals and contracts to campaign reporting and client support.
 The ideal candidate is organized, communicates clearly, pays close attention to detail, and thrives in a fast-paced environment where many moving pieces come together to deliver campaigns on time.
 What You'll Do

- Work closely with Account Executives to prepare, assemble, and submit accurate, client-focused proposals.

- Manage RFP and proposal timelines so every component is delivered ahead of deadlines.

- Gather information from internal teams, such as availability, specs, and visuals, to support proposals.

- Maintain and update proposal templates, rates, and content libraries.

- Administer the contract process from creation to execution, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.

- Enter all sales-related information into the Content Management System (CMS) and keep records accurate.

- Create and process forms and documentation related to sales agreements and client accounts.

- Prepare and deliver Proof of Performance (POP) reports that show clients the results of their campaigns.

- Respond promptly to client inquiries and requests for information or support.

- Coordinate with marketing, creative, inventory, operations, and real estate teams so campaign schedules align with asset availability.

- Maintain accurate client and campaign data in the CMS and CRM systems.

- Help the sales team generate reports and track key sales performance metrics.

- Monitor campaign timelines and make sure all deliverables meet client expectations.

- Support Account Executives in preparing client presentations.

 Qualifications
 Required Qualifications

- Associate's degree or higher.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Comfortable with data entry and working in CMS and CRM systems.

- Team player who works just as well alongside management as independently.

- Tenacious work ethic.

- Professional English communication skills.

 Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree.

- Previous experience in sales coordination, sales support, or account administration.

- Strong interest in real estate development or advertising.

- Billboard or outdoor advertising experience is a plus but not necessary.

- Experience preparing proposals, contracts, or client reports.

 What We're Looking For
 The right person will be:

- Highly organized and dependable.

- Detail-oriented and accurate.

- Proactive and responsive with both clients and internal teams.

- Thoughtful and creative when solving complex business issues.

- Enthusiastic about meeting new people and building relationships.

 Growth Opportunity
 This is a great opportunity to join a company operating in some of the largest advertising markets in the United States. You will gain hands-on experience across sales, operations, and client management, and you can take on more responsibility as you grow with the team.
 This is a remote/telecommute position.

Remote — Latin America | Full-time | US$1,000 per month plus retention bonuses 
 About the role
 Community Sports Partners is looking for a customer-focused specialist to help customers enjoy our sports programs, resolve problems and keep coming back. You will own service enquiries through resolution, understand why customers may leave, and help them find an appropriate next step.
 Responsibilities

- Respond to customer enquiries by phone, email and SMS with clear, accurate information and timely follow-through.

- Investigate complaints, coordinate solutions with operations and keep the customer informed until the issue is resolved.

- Proactively follow up with customers at risk of leaving, understand the underlying concern and explain appropriate options within company policies.

- Handle renewal and re-enrolment conversations and approved campaigns to win back former customers.

- Maintain accurate CRM notes, follow-up commitments and reasons for cancellations or non-renewal.

- Escalate refund, credit or policy exceptions for approval and respect customer decisions.

- Report recurring service issues and opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and retention.

 Working hours
 This is a full-time role with Toronto/Eastern evening and weekend coverage. Exact shifts and weekly hours will be agreed before hiring. Applicants across Latin America are welcome.
 How success is assessed
 Quality and timeliness of resolution, customer satisfaction, renewal and retention outcomes, and accurate follow-through. Targets and the retention bonus plan will be explained during hiring.
 Current vacancy
 This posting is for a current vacancy. We use AI-assisted tools to support application review; hiring decisions are made by people.
 Requirements
 What you bring

- Customer-service experience, ideally with renewals, retention or complaint resolution.

- Excellent spoken and written English and confidence handling customer conversations by phone.

- Empathy, sound judgment and the ability to explain options clearly under pressure.

- Reliable organization, attention to detail and experience maintaining CRM or support-system records.

- Evidence of your own actions and results, distinguishing personal achievements from team performance.

- A reliable remote-working setup and availability for the agreed customer-service schedule.

 How to apply
 Submit your résumé and answer the application questions with specific examples of your own work. Complete both assessments using the same name and email as your application.

- Culture Index survey

- English Criteria GAME assessment

 Benefits
 Pay and location
 Remote within Latin America. Base pay: US$1,000 per month, plus performance-based retention bonuses. Bonus arrangements will be discussed before hiring.
